hero-knight.text: Dung hiep si, mu sat giap bac, ro o 70px. Khien tron sau vai gan nhu khong thay, chi lo mot mep vang.

hero-axeman.text: Dat: rau, vam vo, riu vac vai, mau do chu dao.

hero-swordsman.text: Dat: khan buoc dau cam, kiem manh sau vai.

hero-archer.text: Dat: mu trum xanh la, cung va mui ten sau vai.

hero-mage.text: Dat: mu nhon tim, gay phep co da sang.

castle-health.text: Dat: tim do truoc thap thanh.

castle-attack.text: Dat: mui ten lua bay cheo len tu chau mai.

castle-skill.text: Dat: set, bong tuyet, co co vu gop mot hinh.

coin.text: Dat: dong xu vang ro o 40px.
